title: How to Download Videos from X (Twitter) the Easy Way
description: How to download videos from X (Twitter) to your phone or laptop with no app and no login. Copy the post link, paste it into I Need Save and pick a quality.
photoCaption: Downloading a video from an X post.
photo2Caption: Copy the link with the Share icon.
body:
X, formerly known as Twitter, is often where viral videos show up first: news clips, sports moments and memes everyone is talking about. The catch is that saving those videos to your gallery isn't always as easy as pressing a button. Don't worry, you can still download videos from X (Twitter) easily with I Need Save. It's free, with no app and no login.

This guide covers the steps on phone and computer, the file options you'll get, and what to do if a download fails.

Before You Start

Make sure the video you want to save comes from a public post. Posts from protected accounts, content that can only be viewed after logging in, and content restricted to certain regions can't be downloaded.

You also don't need to give access to your X account. I Need Save only needs the post link.

How to Download Videos from X (Twitter) on Your Phone

These steps work on Android and iPhone:

  1. Open the X app and find the post with the video you want to save.
  2. Tap the Share button on the post.
  3. Choose Copy link.
  4. Open your browser and go to ineedsave.com.
  5. Paste the link into the box, or tap the Paste button.
  6. Press Download and wait for the file options to appear.
  7. Choose the video quality you want, and the download will begin.

Sometimes the button shows Preparing…. That means the video is being processed first, for example a stream is being converted to MP4 or the video and audio are being joined. Keep the page open, and the download starts automatically as soon as the file is ready.

How to Download X Videos on a Laptop or PC

If you use X in your computer's browser, it's just as easy:

  1. Open the post that contains the video.
  2. Copy its link from the Share menu or the address bar.
  3. Open the downloader page in a new tab and paste the link.
  4. Click Download, then choose the option you want.

The file will be saved in the Downloads folder on your computer.

The Options You'll See

Once the link is processed, I Need Save shows options based on the original post. You'll usually find:

  • Video in several qualities, such as 360p, 720p or 1080p. The available resolutions depend on the uploaded video.
  • Audio, either in original quality or as a 192 kbps MP3 converted from the video.
  • Photo / Thumbnail from the post.

The audio option comes in handy when all you need is the sound, such as part of an interview or a piece of music. You can read the full steps in our article on how to convert social media videos to MP3.

Tip: If you just want to rewatch on your phone, 720p is usually clear enough and takes up less storage than 1080p.

Why Use I Need Save?

A few things make this method practical for everyday use:

  • No app. Everything runs in the browser, so your phone storage isn't used up by an extra app.
  • No login. You don't need to create an account or connect your X account.
  • Not just X. The same method works for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky and other supported platforms.
  • Comfortable to use. The site is available in 93 languages and follows your device's light or dark theme.

Where Files Go After Downloading

  • Android and computer: files go to the Downloads folder. On Android, the Gallery app may take a moment before showing them.
  • iPhone/iPad (Safari): files go to the Files app, in the Downloads folder. To move a video to the Photos app, open it in Files, tap Share, then choose Save Video.

Downloaded MP4 videos have the correct duration and play in gallery apps. Files are also streamed directly from X to your device, without being stored on the I Need Save server.

If the Download Fails

Here are the most common causes:

  • Protected account. Videos from private accounts can't be fetched.
  • Login required. Content that can only be viewed after signing in can't be downloaded either.
  • Region restrictions. Videos limited to certain countries aren't available.
  • Wrong link. Make sure you copied the post link, not a profile link. Copy it again from the Share button.

Don't Forget the Etiquette

Save videos for personal use. If you want to share one on another platform, ask the creator for permission and give credit. Respecting copyright keeps creators motivated to keep making things. Also read the ethics and copyright of downloading content for a fuller explanation.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does I Need Save work on iPhone?

Yes. Open ineedsave.com in Safari, follow the same steps, then find the video in the Files app.

Do I have to log in to my X account?

No. Just paste the link of a public post, with no login and no account needed.

Why does the button show Preparing…?

The video is being processed, for example a stream is being converted to MP4. The download starts automatically once it's done.
